question.text: A uniform cylinder of length $\mathrm{L}$ and mass $M$ having cross-sectional area $\mathrm{A}$ is suspended, with its length vertical, from a fixed point by a massless spring, such that it is half submerged in a liquid of density $\sigma$ at equilibrium position. When the cylinder is given a downward push and released, it starts oscillating vertically with a small amplitude. The time period $\mathrm{T}$ of the oscillations of the cylinder will be :
